public_rationale: Human learning experiments support the model-building clause, and extraction experiments establish substantial LLM memorization. But Llama-2 research also finds structured representations of space and time. The evidence therefore supports parts of the sentence while challenging its contrast between memorization and model-building. It establishes neither whole-internet memorization nor human-equivalent mental models in LLMs.
limitations: The result depends on reading the sentence as a contrast between modes of learning, rather than merely saying humans and LLMs differ.
Representation probes do not establish conscious experience or a complete world model.
Selected book extractions cannot measure memorization across the whole training corpus.
